source_positions.position_rule: raw-edge-weighted centroid of the source cell's coordinate-bearing direct inputs; left-eye horizontal coordinate reflected into common image coordinates

limitations: Frozen T4/T5 subtype direction labels are part of this diagnostic mechanism.
A pass would localize a candidate radial pooling rule but cannot validate the upstream biological direction gate.
Inferred receptive-field centroids are connectivity proxies, not measured receptive fields.
All unmapped, silent, and low-response LPLC2 targets remain in the fixed denominator.
